zh.text: 模组下载的断点续传真的生效了：下载失败不再删掉半截包（只有换到别的下载来源时才丢弃），重试能从断点接着下
慢网也能把大模组下完：保底速度从 256 KB/s 放宽到 64 KB/s，单次分片从 64 MiB 缩到 16 MiB
修掉「某个模组版本在这台机器上永远装不上」：校验失败、空文件、本地残包异常时都会清场，不再自锁
模组的「取消下载」不再是假取消：点了真的会停下来，不会再出现「以为取消了、其实装上了」
点过「取消」或校验失败过的版本，后台检查不会每半小时又自动重下一次；手动点「立即更新」仍然照下
已经下载好的更新包不会再被后台检查重新下载，界面也不会每一轮都掉回「立即更新」
更新包不会再有两次下载同时写同一个文件（会自动互斥），避免下出一个坏包
更新包下载改成先写临时文件、校验通过才改名，启动时清理不再误删「已经下好、只差点安装」的包
模组包与分片的临时文件有地方清了：「清空缓存」现在会一并清掉，不再无声占用 GB 级磁盘
校验 1.9 GB 分片不再把整个文件读进内存（峰值从约 1.8 GB 降到常量级），小内存机器也能装大包
服务端不支持断点续传（回 200 整包）时，大包不再必然超时；镜像回的区间起点不对会当场识破，而不是拼出一个坏包
超时提示的数字不再乱报：以前 30 秒失败会写成「请求超时（7307s）」，现在按实际阶段报秒数
宇宙配置与配置中心里没保存的改动不再因为切页而丢失；关窗口时也会拦截提醒
服务启动预算从 60 秒放宽到 90 秒（实测空模组就要 51.8 秒、冷缓存首轮 66.4 秒，以前会误报「已超出预算」）
次级文字（时间戳、说明）对比度从 2.97:1 提到 5.62:1，达到无障碍 AA 标准
开机画面的「最多等」参数修正（原来比「最少显示」还短，永不生效），后端不回应时能按预期收起
启动器起服与更新的临时文件命名不再撞名（同一毫秒的两次操作会互相清目录），也顺手消掉了一个偶发的测试失败

en.text: Resumable mod downloads actually work now: a failed attempt no longer deletes the partial file (only switching to another mirror does), so a retry continues where it stopped
Large mods download over slow links: the transfer floor is now 64 KB/s (was 256) and each range request is 16 MiB (was 64)
Fixed "this mod version can never be installed on this machine": verification failures, empty files and odd leftover packages are now cleaned up instead of self-locking
Cancelling a mod download really cancels it - the launcher no longer installs a mod you thought you cancelled
A version you cancelled or that failed verification is no longer re-downloaded automatically every 30 minutes; the manual "update now" button still retries
An already downloaded update package is no longer downloaded again by the background check, and the prompt no longer falls back to "update now" every round
Two update downloads can no longer write the same file at once (they are mutually exclusive), which used to produce a broken package
Update packages are written to a temporary file and renamed only after verification, so the startup cleanup no longer deletes a package that was downloaded and waiting to install
Mod packages and split parts can be cleaned up: "clear cache" now removes them too instead of letting them occupy gigabytes silently
Hashing a 1.9 GB split part no longer loads the whole file into memory (peak dropped from about 1.8 GB to constant)

When a server ignores range requests and returns the whole file, large downloads no longer time out every time; a mirror that reports the wrong range start is detected immediately instead of producing a corrupt package
Timeout messages no longer print wrong numbers - a 30 second failure used to read "request timed out (7307s)"
Unsaved changes in the game configuration and the config centre are no longer lost when switching pages, and closing the window now prompts
The service start budget was raised from 60s to 90s (measured: 51.8s with no mods, 66.4s on a cold cache, which used to report "budget exceeded")
Secondary text (timestamps, captions) contrast raised from 2.97:1 to 5.62:1, meeting WCAG AA
Fixed the boot screen "wait at most" value (it was shorter than the minimum display and never took effect), so it now closes as intended when the backend stays silent
Temporary file names for service and update work no longer collide (two operations in the same millisecond used to delete each other's directories), which also removed a flaky test
